body:
## Pull request overview

This PR significantly expands ObjectUI's component coverage by adding missing shadcn UI components, creating renderers for all documented components, adding comprehensive TypeScript type definitions, and restructuring documentation with collapsible category navigation.

**Changes:**
- Adds 3 new UI components (toast system with Radix UI primitives, date-picker with calendar popup, combobox with search)
- Creates 14 component renderers eliminating "unknown type" errors
- Adds complete TypeScript schemas for all new components across feedback, form, layout, data-display, disclosure, overlay, and navigation categories
- Provides comprehensive fumadocs documentation for 30 components organized in collapsible category folders

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 75 out of 75 changed files in this pull request and generated 8 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/types/src/overlay.ts | Adds MenubarSchema and MenubarMenu types for menubar component |
| packages/types/src/navigation.ts | Adds PaginationSchema (with currentPage/page dual support), NavigationMenuSchema, ButtonGroupSchema, and duplicate BreadcrumbSchema |
| packages/types/src/layout.ts | Adds AspectRatioSchema with image and children support |
| packages/types/src/form.ts | Adds ComboboxSchema and CommandSchema for searchable selection components |
| packages/types/src/feedback.ts | Adds SpinnerSchema, EmptySchema, and SonnerSchema |
| packages/types/src/disclosure.ts | Adds ToggleGroupSchema with selectionType property |
| packages/types/src/data-display.ts | Adds duplicate BreadcrumbSchema and KbdSchema |
| packages/components/src/ui/toast.tsx | Implements Radix UI toast primitives with invalid HTML attribute |
| packages/components/src/ui/toaster.tsx | Implements Toaster component for rendering toast notifications |
| packages/components/src/ui/date-picker.tsx | Implements date picker with calendar popup using date-fns |
| packages/components/src/ui/combobox.tsx | Implements searchable combobox using Command component |
| packages/components/src/hooks/use-toast.ts | Implements toast state management hook with restrictive TOAST_LIMIT |
| packages/components/src/renderers/* | Implements 14 renderers following ObjectUI patterns with some functional gaps |
| packages/components/src/ui/index.ts | Exports new components and renames Toaster to ToastNotifier |
| packages/components/src/index.ts | Exports useToast hook |
| docs/components/meta.json | Restructures navigation to use collapsible folder references |
| docs/components/*/meta.json | Updates category meta files with complete component lists |
| docs/components/*/*.mdx | Adds comprehensive documentation for 30 components with schemas and examples |
</details>

## Unused variable, import, function or class

Unused variable showEllipsis.

[Show more details](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/security/code-scanning/64)

## Unused variable, import, function or class

Unused import renderChildren.

[Show more details](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/security/code-scanning/65)

The pagination component uses hardcoded "#" href values for all links (lines 50, 57, 64), which prevents actual page navigation. The component should utilize the onPageChange handler from the schema or construct proper href values based on the page numbers to enable functional navigation.

The documentation shows a "type" property on line 45 and in the schema on line 66 for selection mode, but the actual TypeScript schema uses "selectionType" (as seen in packages/types/src/disclosure.ts line 147). This inconsistency between documentation and implementation will confuse users. The documentation should use "selectionType" to match the actual schema interface.

BreadcrumbItem and BreadcrumbSchema are defined twice: once in data-display.ts (lines 615-640) and once in navigation.ts (lines 163-200). This creates duplicate type definitions which can cause TypeScript compilation errors and confusion. The types should be defined in only one location. Based on the shadcn/ui categorization, breadcrumb is typically a navigation component, so it should be in navigation.ts only and removed from data-display.ts.

The TOAST_LIMIT is set to 1, which only allows a single toast to be displayed at a time. This is overly restrictive and not standard behavior for toast notifications. The limit should be increased to a more reasonable number like 3-5 toasts to allow multiple notifications to be shown simultaneously while preventing overwhelming the UI.

The "toast-close" attribute on line 89 is not a valid HTML attribute. This should be removed or converted to a data attribute (e.g., "data-toast-close") to comply with HTML standards and avoid potential validation issues.

The aspect-ratio renderer does not handle the schema.children property defined in AspectRatioSchema (line 424 in types/src/layout.ts). The renderer only checks schema.body but should also support schema.children as an alternative syntax, matching the type definition.
